$comment: Advisories accepted by scripts/security/npm-audit.mjs. Add one only after checking that it cannot reach a shipped artifact, give the reason, and set an expiry no more than ~3 months out.

advisories.reason: ReDoS in picomatch <=4.0.7 with no patched release yet. Reached only through build tooling (vite, vite-plugin-pwa, vue-router's unplugin entry) with repo-controlled globs; the app image ships static dist/ on nginx and vue-router's runtime entry does not include picomatch.
